briefs: Create a luminous architectural print: saturated colour fields, careful structural linework, real curves and unusually attentive window/cornice detail. Keep the image alive rather than diagrammatic.

Create a luminous architectural print: saturated colour fields, careful structural linework, real curves and unusually attentive window/cornice detail. Keep the image alive rather than diagrammatic.

Preference-informed guidance from the owner’s first 22 comparisons (a provisional hypothesis, not a learned reward): favour sharp, coherent architectural lines; keep adjoining buildings structurally consistent rather than as decorative rectangles. Add selective brick/material articulation, joinery and cornice detail where the photograph supports it. Make trees specific in silhouette and branching rather than a generic cloud of dots. Avoid wonky junctions, drifting window rows and ornamental noise. Relative faithfulness alone did not make an image worth keeping: retain deliberate composition, immersive colour and lively printed/painted material, not sterile CAD precision. Do not invent details or copy another building.

arms: same brief plus provisional human preference guidance
experiment.selection: Eight source photographs selected for architectural contrast before generation; excludes all four previously painted source posts. Not a random population sample.
experiment.protocol: One fresh program per arm per source, each with one own-render revision opportunity. Same model, medium, code budget and renderer. Arm positions counterbalanced across sources. Failures retained; no training or automatic beauty score.
